name: Anchor3DGS
definition: A pose-free feed-forward 3DGS framework that replaces pixel-aligned paradigms with a compact anchor-based representation. It places a fixed number of 3D anchors on a geometry-aware scaffold, decoupling Gaussian count from input resolution/view count, and allocates capacity based on scene content.
summary: Anchor3DGS is a pose-free, feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that uses a compact anchor-based representation to achieve high-quality rendering with significantly fewer primitives than pixel-aligned methods.
